title: Map: Detachment C and the Indonesian Revolt, 1958
description: Map of Southeast Asia titled "Detachment C and the Indonesian Revolt, 1958," covering China, Indochina, the Philippines, Indonesia and northern Australia. Annotations include "Detachment C moved from Japan, 24 March," a forward processing center at Cubi Point Naval Air Station established 26 March, "CIA arms delivery, mid-April," "CIA support for captured island, 27 April" (Morotai), "Dissident uprising, 10 February" (Padang), "Government troops retake city, 17 April," "US advisors evacuated, 1 May" and "Capture of Allen Pope, 17 May" (Ambon). Marked Secret NOFORN.
